build_devectorizer: build a Devectorizer instance with a Cloner and Sizer to devectorize BMG graph nodes
assess_node_devectorizer: assess a BMG node with Devectorizer.assess_node to check if it can be devectorized
transform_node_devectorizer: transform a BMG node using Devectorizer.transform_node to split, scatter, or merge it
create_vectorized_graph_fixer: create a sequential GraphFixer with vectorized_graph_fixer that tensorizes then detensorizes a BMG graph
review_devectorize_transformation_enum: review the DevectorizeTransformation enum to understand YES, YES_WITH_MERGE, and NO transformation types
